auditor.model_detail: The independent reviewer was spawned with this model override; the reviewer runtime did not expose an additional deployment identifier.

audit_history.initial_blocker: Saved float32 LoRA weights were loaded into float16 adapter parameters before being converted back to float32, changing predictions after reload.

target_label_provenance.finding: Targets are released synthetic compliance-contract labels, not prediction-derived references; most evaluated records remain pending expert review.

self_normalization.finding: Prediction uses the maximum summed conditional log probability of the complete canonical label and end token, with no model-output normalization denominator.

raw_prediction_recomputation.finding: Stored row-level predictions reproduce reported classification, pair, seed-summary and clustered-bootstrap metrics.

before_after_fairness.finding: Base and tuned models use the same fixed records, prompts, tokenizer, candidate labels and scoring rule.

checkpoint_selection.finding: Epoch selection uses validation macro-F1 and validation target loss; all three declared seeds are retained.

saved_adapter_reload.finding: LoRA parameters are converted to float32 before saved weights are loaded; all three 350-record replays have zero changed labels.

five_key_provenance_isolation.finding: No selected-sample or controlled-probe-source overlap was found across source_group, source_record_id, scenario_id, source_simulation_case_id and operation_group.

scientific_scope.finding: The result is limited to a synthetic, label-balanced, closed-set compliance contract. Probe-source review status is explicitly reported for 32 source records and 64 rendered records.

scientific_scope_limits: No physical or executable-control improvement claim.
No live, online or production performance claim.
No superiority claim over the same-sample character n-gram TF-IDF baseline.
State-change and request-variant results remain small controlled diagnostics.
